description: Implementation of a stub audio decoder for the starboard media framework, including methods for initialization, decoding buffers, handling end of stream, and creating decoded audio data.

classes.name: StubAudioDecoder
classes.description: A stub implementation of an audio decoder that generates synthetic audio data for testing or placeholder purposes.

methods.name: GetSupportedSampleType
methods.description: Determines the supported audio sample type, preferring float32 if supported, otherwise int16.

methods.name: CalculateFramesPerInputBuffer
methods.description: Calculates the number of audio frames per input buffer based on timestamps.

methods.name: CreateDecodedAudio
methods.description: Creates a DecodedAudio object filled with synthetic data, either int16 or float samples.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Schedules decoding of input buffers on a background thread.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end of stream by pushing an empty DecodedAudio object.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::Read
methods.description: Reads decoded audio data, returning the next available DecodedAudio object.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, clearing buffers and stopping background jobs.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::DecodeBuffers
methods.description: Processes input buffers to generate decoded audio.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer into synthetic audio data.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end of stream, generating final decoded audio.
